kind: Real Koha 25.11 / MariaDB; all Firebase traffic forbidden

rows.name: Native documents: all nine module namespaces persist Unicode, timestamps and unknown fields
Native updates and merges retain unrelated fields; missing updates fail
Atomic batches roll back every write on a missing document
Concurrent increments are retried without losing any count
Two reservations compete for one place with a single successful atomic booking
Native queries: collection boundaries, date comparisons, arrays, sort and limit
Collections larger than one API page are fully read without truncation
Native subscriptions see writes and stop after disposal
Import preview is read-only; existing fields and concurrent creations are preserved
Old JSON formats retain subcollections, IDs and timestamp values
PMK data manager previews an uploaded file and imports after explicit click
Configuration import keeps custom fields and rows while applying the imported choices
Native API refuses missing request header, malformed paths and anonymous access
Staff identity comes from Koha; staff cannot export or modify managed referentials
Authorities open with their audit settings and without the former learning service
